donor.use_rule: Research/spec donor only. Do not copy donor audio or scenario text into F2 fixtures.

purpose: Test whether German disfluency, semantic correction and multi-step tool use violate F2 causal/tool/interruption invariants in combinations not exercised by isolated component tests.

pilot_matrix.oracle: Only corrected arguments may reach the deterministic mock tool; superseded values must produce zero tool calls.
Abandoned intent must not create a tool/effect request; later explicit intent owns the turn.
Second call consumes only the exact result identity of the first admitted call; no invented or stale dynamic reference.
Correction creates a new causally bound query; prior result cannot silently satisfy the corrected request.
Interrupted response stops playback at measured boundary; late tool result may be retained only under explicit current-turn ownership and must not resurrect cancelled output.
Old-turn result is traceable but cannot mutate newer-turn authoritative context/effect state without a valid causal handoff.

Apply T7_INTERRUPTED_CONTEXT_RETAIN_HEARD_PREFIX_EPHEMERALLY_ONLY_V1: retain only measured heard prefix ephemerally, exclude unheard tail, stop actual sink playback, keep durable writes at zero unless separately admitted.
Duplicate result cannot double-apply state or regain producer ownership; replay identity remains stable.
Tool arguments preserve exact intended identifiers despite German speech rhythm, spelling, hyphenation and code-switched names; uncertainty fails closed rather than guessing.
No tool call before required arguments are semantically complete; latency optimization must not outrun intent certainty.

execution_contract.preferred_evaluator: deterministic exact tool selection + typed argument oracle + causal identity/readback checks
execution_contract.preferred_execution_surface: lowest safe faithful admitted VPS sandbox/controller route

pilot_stop_rule: Run the smallest orthogonal subset first. Scale only if at least one new product-negative or evidence-validity class appears beyond current HF02-HF10/WP715 coverage; otherwise close as REDUNDANT_NO_NEW_INFORMATION.
next_exact_action: Trigger4 reviews overlap against current HF/WP715 tests, selects the smallest genuinely orthogonal subset (prefer DE_TOOL_05, DE_TOOL_07 and one correction/rollback case), implements it with original German fixtures and deterministic mock tools, and executes through existing admitted VPS/controller authority. If overlap is complete, record REDUNDANT_NO_NEW_INFORMATION and do not build a second benchmark framework.
